outcomeNote: A mishna stating the treasurer's obligations, with one dissenting addition by Rabbi Eliezer.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ חַיָּיבֵי עֲרָכִין מְמַשְׁכְּנִין (אוֹתוֹ) [אוֹתָן], נוֹתְנִין לוֹ מְזוֹן שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם, וּכְסוּת שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ, מִטָּה מוּצַּעַת, וְסַנְדָּלָיו, וּתְפִלָּיו — לוֹ, אֲבָל לֹא לְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּלְבָנָיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Although» the Sages «said» (21a): With regard to those «obligated» to pay «valuations,» the court «repossesses their» property to pay their debt to the Temple treasury; nevertheless, the treasurer «gives him» permission to keep «food» sufficient for «thirty days, and garments» sufficient for «twelve months,» and «a bed made» with linens, «and his sandals, and his phylacteries.» The treasurer leaves these items «for him, but» he does «not» leave items «for his wife or for his children.»

segments.he: אִם הָיָה אוּמָּן — נוֹתֵן לוֹ שְׁנֵי כְּלֵי אוּמָּנוּת מִכׇּל מִין וּמִין, חָרָשׁ — נוֹתְנִין לוֹ שְׁנֵי מַעֲצָדִין וּשְׁנֵי מְגֵירוֹת. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: אִם הָיָה אִיכָּר — נוֹתֵן לוֹ צִמְדּוֹ, חַמָּר — נוֹתֵן לוֹ חֲמוֹרוֹ.
segments.en: «If» the one obligated to pay «was a craftsman,» the treasurer «gives him» permission to keep «two tools of» his «craft of each and every type,» e.g., for «a carpenter,» the treasurer «gives him» permission to keep «two adzes [matzadin] and two saws. Rabbi Eliezer says: If he was a farmer,» the treasurer «gives him» permission to keep «his pair» of oxen with which he plows the field. If he was «a donkey driver,» the treasurer «gives him» permission to keep «his donkey.»

segments.he: הָיָה לוֹ מִין אֶחָד מְרוּבֶּה וּמִין אֶחָד מוּעָט — אֵין אוֹמֵר לִמְכּוֹר אֶת הַמְרוּבֶּה וְלִיקַּח מִן הַמּוּעָט, אֶלָּא נוֹתְנִין לוֹ שְׁנֵי מִינִין מִן הַמְרוּבֶּה וְכֹל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ מִן הַמּוּעָט. הַמַּקְדִּישׁ נְכָסָיו — מַעֲלִין לוֹ תְּפִילָּיו.
segments.en: If «one had many» tools of «one type and few» tools of «one» other «type,» e.g., three adzes and one saw, «he» may «not say» to the treasurer «to sell» one tool «of the» type of which he has «many and to purchase» for him one tool «of the» type of which he has «few. Rather,» the treasurer «gives him two» tools «of the type» of which he has «many and» he retains «whatever he has of the» type of which he has «few.» In contrast to one whose property is repossessed to pay valuations, from «one who consecrates» all «his property,» the treasurer «takes his phylacteries,» as they are included in the category of all his property.

moves.cueHe: אף על פי שאמרו חייבי ערכין ממשכנין אותן
moves.summary: qualifies the earlier ruling on repossession: the debtor is left food, clothing, bedding, sandals and phylacteries, but nothing for wife and children
moves.about: the mishna concedes the earlier ruling that the court repossesses the property of those obligated to pay valuations

moves.summary: extends the list: a craftsman keeps two tools of each type of his craft
moves.about: whether a farmer's yoke of oxen and a donkey driver's donkey count as tools of his craft that are left to him when his property is repossessed

moves.summary: adds that a farmer keeps his oxen and a donkey driver his donkey

moves.cueHe: היה לו מין אחד מרובה ומין אחד מועט
moves.summary: one may not sell surplus tools of one type to buy tools of a scarce type
contrasts the repossessed debtor with one who consecrates all his property, whose phylacteries are taken
